base: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a transparent PNG modular sprite atlas for Scrapshift based on the attached original robot art. Preserve its warm ivory metal, charcoal outline, muted ochre and mint style, but radically simplify its anatomy. EXACTLY 9 separated components in a regular 3-column by 3-row grid, square 1536 canvas, ample transparent space between cells, no text. Row 1: (1) a plain front-facing rounded ivory egg-shaped robot SHELL ONLY, slightly taller than wide, NO FACE, no black face panel, no eyes, no mouth, no ears, no headphones, no antenna, no side protrusions, no legs, no hands, very simple soft shading and just two small metal seams; (2) one SMALL tapered ivory metal LEG, short curved teardrop spike pointing down, charcoal outline, no foot, no shoe, no rounded sole; (3) one pair of friendly oval dark charcoal eyes with tiny mint highlights on transparency, NO face behind. Row 2: (4) one pair of stern narrow dark eyes on transparency; (5) one pair of sleepy half-lidded eyes on transparency; (6) one simple small curved charcoal smiling mouth line on transparency. Row 3: (7) one compact grey wire-brush moustache and triangular beard as a combined face accessory on transparency; (8) one short ochre swept hair tuft formed from 3 simple metal plates, no head; (9) one short rusty-orange mohawk crest formed from three metal fins, no head. All components isolated, centered inside their own equal square cell. Body should occupy about 70% of first cell width and 80% height. Render all other components large inside their cells, engine will scale. Strictly no complete assembled character except the blank shell; no scene, no shadow, no captions, no labels, no backdrop. Strong clean silhouette readable at 64 pixels.
wearables: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent PNG sprite atlas of wearable robot embellishments for Scrapshift, matching the attached original modular robot's ivory/ochre/charcoal/mint outlined painterly cartoon style. EXACTLY 24 isolated accessory sprites in an evenly spaced SIX-column FOUR-row grid on landscape 1536x1024 canvas. No bodies, no complete characters, no words, no text, no item cards, no backgrounds or shadows. Each sprite centered in its cell with ample fully transparent margins. These are small facial/skin/hair pieces applied onto a round robot, NOT inventory icons: avoid containers/bottles/food objects. In row-major order: ROW1: (1) ochre knitted beanie cap with curved underside that sits on oval head; (2) charcoal safety helmet with ochre stripe and curved underside; (3) two small crossed sticking-plaster strips; (4) ivory horned skull forehead crest; (5) round dark-rimmed spectacles pair with mint glass lenses; (6) charcoal cloth blindfold strip with two small knot ends. ROW2: (7) simple brown chest armor bib with rounded upper edge; (8) pair tiny charcoal bat wings joined at center for behind body; (9) compact spiky metal back plate; (10) little moss-green scalp sprouts; (11) three ivory branch antlers joined by short base; (12) crooked black mouth with one broken ivory tooth. ROW3: (13) pair wide caffeinated eyes with tiny mint pupils; (14) small cream moustache smudge for mouth; (15) pair angry coral eyebrows with dark eyes; (16) single large mint cyclops eye in charcoal socket; (17) small cracked rusty cheek patch; (18) mint translucent rounded scalp slime tuft. ROW4: (19) three subtle coral vein lines radiating across a cheek; (20) tiny steel neck injector stud with coral center; (21) small ochre lucky star cheek decal; (22) pair spiraling charcoal eyes with mint pupils; (23) tiny dark-red curved leech mark for neck; (24) three small coral cheek stitch marks. Consistent bold charcoal edges. Keep strictly detached embellishments; NO complete head or face base behind eyes. Do not draw hands, legs, feet, guns, UI, captions or logos.
